supplemental_gap_receipt.timing: Additional official endpoint availability check after implementation; no numerical data introduced or consumed.

source_policy: Original official NIST response bytes are saved with URL, request body, timestamp, byte count and SHA256 before dependent implementation. The photon tables are NIST SRD126 X-Ray Mass Attenuation Coefficients (Hubbell/Seltzer), not an invented XCOM mu_en output; XCOM proper does not supply mu_en.
construction: Explicit emitted line/quadrature-node energies in MeV and nonnegative number weights per supplied event/normalization, never inferred from AME Q or inclusive capture cross sections.
Explicit finite ordered photon paths, each with probability and ordered material layers of areal density g/cm2 and Ni/H mass fractions. No periodic simulation cell is used as an absorber boundary.

Within source domains only, declared piecewise log-log numerical interpolation on each side of an absorption edge. This is not the NIST internal subshell interpolation algorithm, and carries no new accuracy guarantee. Exact edge energy requires below/above side. Duplicate edge rows remain distinct. No eV extrapolation or new medium fit.

Uncollided transmission exp(-sum_j (mu/rho)_j X_j). Mixture attenuation uses mass-fraction additivity per NIST chapter2. Pure-element layers additionally integrate primary collision kerma: incoming_energy*(mu_en/mu)*(1-exp(-mu*X)). This is an energy bookkeeping allocation, not measured deposited heat. Secondary scattered/fluorescent/annihilation/bremsstrahlung radiation remains unresolved, not falsely classified as escaping.

Elemental mu_en mass additivity is formally incorrect per NIST chapter3. Homogeneous mixed Ni/H layers therefore produce attenuation and unresolved removed energy, not an invented mixture absorption coefficient. Ordered pure-element layers can give conditional collision-kerma allocations; applying their coefficients assumes secondary slowing in the same pure medium and does not establish finite-layer charged-particle containment.

For available primary STAR tables, specified charged track areal length gives R_out=max(R(E_in)-X,0), inverted only within the tabulated domain or exactly at complete stopping. Track length is not projected depth or a straight chord. Range inversion does not establish angular scattering, straggling, containment or thermalization.

Electron bremsstrahlung generation over a slowing segment uses E_in*Y(E_in)-E_out*Y(E_out); remaining kinetic loss is collision slowing, not automatically heat. Proton/alpha losses remain unpartitioned electronic+nuclear slowing, with source stopping components reported separately, not apportioned using an initial-energy ratio.

Neutrinos escape only under the explicitly supplied free-streaming assumption. Heavy recoil, neutron, positron and unavailable charged-medium cases remain explicit unresolved carrier budgets. Positron rest/annihilation energies are never synthesized from kinetic energy.

Energy compartments conserve supplied emitted kinetic/radiative energy; rest mass, unsupplied cascades, reaction rates and Q-to-heat conversion are excluded. No two-body branch example is required or asserted.
source_gaps: Nickel is absent from official PSTAR/ASTAR selectors. Direct official matno=028 POST responses also contain no numerical rows; exact original HTTP200 empty-table responses are bound by supplemental_gap_receipt. Neither copper nor iron substitutes for nickel.
No acquired Ni/H compound-specific mu_en or charged stopping table.
No acquired heavy Ni/Cu/Zn recoil-ion, positron or neutron transport table.
primary_table_limitations: NIST photon tables omit photonuclear interactions, nuclear-resonance and Delbruck scattering; important photonuclear contributions can occur in the 5-40 MeV giant-resonance region.
Near-edge chemical/phase/temperature fine structure is absent from these elemental photon tables. Hydrogen STAR material is the source gas medium, not interstitial H in nickel.
Interpolation is an explicit table-transfer approximation, not a material-model fit or a reproduced native NIST interpolation.
oracle: Independent HTML table-cell parser versus production PRE parser, literal nickel K/L edge rows, hydrogen and STAR literal rows.

Independent Decimal exponential Beer law and pure-element kerma integral; conservation across weighted paths and ordered layers, mixture rejection of fabricated mu_en, edge/domain/unit and missing geometry mutations.
Independent tabulated-range endpoint and geometric log-interpolation checks, CSDA track versus projected-range sensitivity, electron radiative-yield accounting, unresolved recoil/neutrino separation.
cli_contract: No input: source-bound table inventory only, actual material heat null. --input explicit JSON: conditional per-normalization transfer, never actual rate or heat. --output writes JSON. Examples and exact JSON schema are embedded in consume_nuclear_energy_transport.py --help.
execution: No scientific runs/tests/builds/lint/formatters by worker. Root runs the independent oracle and actual primary-table inventory consumer after integration.
